XenotypeDef.label: Tribe Ratkin
XenotypeDef.description: The humanoid race with rodent genes established feudal kingdoms dominated by agricultural life in the peripheral world, but their origins are still unclear to this day.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: The humanoid race with rodent genes established feudal kingdoms dominated by agricultural life in the peripheral world, but their origins are still unclear to this day.

XenotypeDef.label: Initial Ratkin
XenotypeDef.description: The humanoid race with rodent genes established feudal kingdoms dominated by agricultural life in the peripheral world, but their origins are still unclear to this day. The Initial Ratkin, on the other hand, is the most similar branch of the ratkin to the original. Countless years have passed, and they still have not undergone much genetic change.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: The humanoid race with rodent genes established feudal kingdoms dominated by agricultural life in the peripheral world, but their origins are still unclear to this day.

XenotypeDef.label: White Ratkin
XenotypeDef.description: Most of them are middle and high-level members of the ratkin kingdom, or other classes with little labor. The long-term and stable comfortable life has gradually led them to change towards a more favorable direction for governance, so they are not as advantageous in physical labor as other mouse tribes.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Most of them are middle and high-level members of the ratkin kingdom, or other classes with little labor. The long-term and stable comfortable life has gradually led them to change towards a more favorable direction for governance, so they are not as advantageous in physical labor as other mouse tribes.

XenotypeDef.label: Travel Ratkin
XenotypeDef.description: This kind of rat tribe used to be one of the lower class civilians in the ratkin kingdom, until they began their escape and realized how beautiful it was to live freely without oppression.\n\nThousands or even tens of thousands of years of wandering have allowed them to evolve unique genes to adapt to the instability and danger in the wild. For them, every time they open their eyes and find themselves still alive, it is so delightful.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: This kind of rat tribe used to be one of the lower class civilians in the ratkin kingdom, until they began their escape and realized how beautiful it was to live freely without oppression.

XenotypeDef.label: Rock Ratkin
XenotypeDef.description: Due to the fact that most of them live in harsh mountainous environments, this ratkin is not as gentle and docile as others, but rather more straightforward. The long-term mineral rich living environment has made their bodies quite strong, and this strong physique has made them both optimistic and headache inducing in the eyes of kingdom rulers.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Due to the fact that most of them live in harsh mountainous environments, this ratkin is not as gentle and docile as others, but rather more straightforward.

XenotypeDef.label: Snow Ratkin
XenotypeDef.description: These ratkins living in extremely cold places have excellent agility, even the white snow cannot stop them from tracking their prey. The harsh environment of the cold land destined them to grow up alone, hunt in loneliness, and die in loneliness.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: These ratkins living in extremely cold places have excellent agility, even the white snow cannot stop them from tracking their prey.

XenotypeDef.label: Lowland Ratkin
XenotypeDef.description: The Lowland Ratkin is a coastal species of the ratkin race. The rich living environment, convenient maritime transportation, and rich cultural exchanges have enabled the lowland ratkin to evolve excellent manual skills, which have made them highly valued by the kingdom.\n\nBesides their excellent manual skills, their soft big ears are also quite popular. Who wouldn't like their soft mouse ears?
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: The Lowland Ratkin Tribe is a coastal species of the ratkin race, and their excellent geographical advantages have led to the evolution of outstanding manual skills, which have been highly valued.

XenotypeDef.Name: OAGene_BiochemicalRatkinBase
XenotypeDef.description: This type of biochemical species was born in the secretive black laboratory of the kingdom. They may have been gentle or irritable in the past, but now they are no longer the same as before. Instead, after undergoing involuntary genetic modification, they have become specialized experimental victims. According to statistics, few experimental subjects can live to a normal lifespan.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: This experimental subject was born in the secretive black laboratory of the kingdom
